Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 49 (Lumen Technologies missing-address campaign): matched this row to two independent aggregator sources agreeing on the same street address, and resolved a third sources conflicting house number in favor of the two that agreed.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Lumen Technologies is the current legal successor to CenturyLink, which itself absorbed Level 3 Communications in a 2017 acquisition, with the CenturyLink brand renamed Lumen in 2020. Legacy Level 3 branding persists on some facilities and aggregator listings and is preserved in this registry per its no delete policy rather than overwritten. This specific row, Lumen Austin 1, matches this operators own site name. Two independent sources, a datacenters.com listing and a dedicated datacentermap listing, both fetched fresh this session, agree on 4207 Smith School Road, Austin, Texas 78744 as the street address. A third source, Inflect, gave a slightly different house number, 4100 rather than 4207, on the same street, a minor discrepancy this session resolved in favor of the two agreeing sources.
sources_tried: Two independent aggregator listings agreeing on the same specific street address, resolved against a third source giving a conflicting house number on the same street
